author: Marlon Chaviano
name: mobile-kmp
title: App with Kotlin Multiplatform
description: JetBrains' official template: Kotlin Multiplatform with Compose Multiplatform to share logic and UI between Android and iOS.
setupTasks: KMP: open the project in Android Studio or IntelliJ with the Kotlin Multiplatform plugin; for iOS you need Xcode on macOS.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Shared code lives in `composeApp/src/commonMain/` (logic and UI with Compose Multiplatform); platform-specific code in `androidMain/` and `iosMain/` through `expect`/`actual`.
- Prefer multiplatform libraries (Ktor, Koin, kotlinx) over single-platform ones.
- Before finishing: `./gradlew :androidApp:assembleDebug`.
